method: Backtest on resolved traded markets only (volume_fp > 0, result yes/no). Entry = official last_price_dollars; payout $1 if held side == result (market_settlement). 1 contract per market, gross of fees. Never-traded markets excluded (last_price 0.0000 is a default, F-15). CAVEAT (hindsight): last_price is the final traded price, not a price you could necessarily have bought at. Treat this as a calibration description (implied vs realised), not a tradable strategy. Fees, slippage and out-of-sample testing are excluded.
